description:
The image depicts two zebras walking side by side in a dry grassy field, with trees visible in the background. The purpose of the image is to showcase the zebras in their natural habitat.

* Two zebras:
	+ Walking side by side
	+ Black and white stripes
	+ Heads facing opposite directions
	+ One zebra appears to be looking back at the other
* A field of dry grass:
	+ Yellowish-brown color
	+ Tall and sparse
